title: Lee, Erdogan reaffirm ‘blood alliance’ at Seoul state banquet
caption:
A historical bond forged on the battlefield is evolving into a high-tech partnership. South Korea and Turkey are targeting 70 years of cooperation in nuclear energy and defense.
